# Maqbool Essential
Use disciplined, slim product UI like Apple Files and Google Drive. Existing 224px sidebar, 70px header, bundled colorful geometric brand and Maqbool wordmark. Inter 13px body, 12px controls, 22px headings. Light #f7f8f7 canvas white surface #202923 text #e2e8e3 fine dividers. Dark #101113 canvas #191b1f surfaces #23252a inputs #32363d dividers #9cd7b9 action; never dark green. White space is intentional, not oversized. Compact rows, 8px corners, no nested card forests, no giant hero/status cards, no decorative illustrations. One main action and one quiet secondary per surface; less frequent actions in a More menu. Stable 860x760 dialogs: fixed header/tabs/footer, scrolling body. No technical implementation terms. Warnings only at the decision they affect. Do not add fake billing, nav, stats, activity sidebars, avatars or fabricated data policies. Purposeful line icons only, 140ms transitions and reduced-motion support.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the two separate desktop screens (1440x1000) for the **File Detail Modal Preview** in both **Light Mode** and **Dark Mode**, adhering strictly to the **Maqbool Essential** design system.

### Key Design Details:
1. **Calm Workspace Hierarchy**:
   - Clean 224px sidebar with existing navigation (`Home`, `Projects`, `My work`, `Inbox`, and bottom `Settings`), product title **Maqbool**, and the bundled colorful geometric mark.
   - Project header with project title **Studio North** and exact tabs (`Overview`, `Work`, `Timeline`, `Updates`, `Files`, `Delivery`).
   - Clean 13px Inter typography with quiet 1px separators and compact 8px border radiuses.

2. **Fixed Modal Footprint (860x760)**:
   - **Header**: File title `welcome-guide.docx`, `HR-001 · v2` subtitle, and a quiet, secondary `Open for editing` action button alongside the dismiss icon.
   - **Tabs**: Active `Preview` tab with `Versions` and `Linked work` companion tabs.
   - **Body**: Centered, realistic white document sheet (`Studio North — Team Welcome Guide`, operational guidelines, structured workflow conventions, and subtle `Page 1 of 3` pagination), followed by the single muted line: *"Preview may differ from the original."*
   - **Footer**: `Close` secondary action on the left, `Download version` (secondary) and `Add version` (primary) on the right.

3. **Exact Token & Color Compliance**:
   - **Light Mode**: `#f7f8f7` canvas, `#ffffff` modal surface, `#202923` primary text, `#176b50` primary actions, and quiet `#e2e5e2` / `#ebebeb` borders.
   - **Dark Mode**: Exact `#101113` canvas, `#191b1f` modal surface, `#23252a` input/chips, `#32363d` subtle lines, `#eeeeee` text, and `#9cd7b9` mint primary actions (no dark-green background). Centered preview document remains a crisp white document sheet for authentic document fidelity.
